The collaboration / 01

Different histories.
Shared standards.

Duluth Trading was built on the belief that hardworking people deserve smarter, more capable gear. Atlas 46 built its reputation creating purpose-driven tool-carry equipment for people who rely on their gear every day.

Both believe the right gear should do more than hold tools. It should improve access. Increase efficiency. Reduce frustration. And help people work with greater confidence.

Why these two brands ↗
Real work. Better gear.
